extracted.intended_audience: general readers; historians and students of 19th-century American slavery and Lincoln-era history
extracted.subtask_description: Full text of Elizabeth Keckley's 1868 memoir 'Behind the Scenes; or, Thirty Years a Slave, and Four Years in the White House', a first-person slave narrative and recollection of service in the Lincoln White House. The page is the digitized eBook intended for reading or literary/historical research.
